areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: General objective relevant; industrial decarbonization financing with related indicators, but small scale within the programme and indirect link, so restricted adherence.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; roughly 30% of resources, two objectives and indicators on renewables, efficiency and biofuel credit lines; high expected impact.

areas.name: Digital inclusion and connectivity
areas.reason: Strong adherence; over 40% of resources on connectivity, digital platforms and industry digitalization credit; high expected impact for digital inclusion.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: General objective directly related; digitalization and interoperability targets for municipalities; moderate impact given the initiatives' relative weight, so limited adherence.

areas.name: Health (SUS)
areas.reason: Digital health projects exist in a product, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets measure impact on public health access.

areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Education credit lines exist, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets on education quality.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Women-led business support is mentioned but not formally linked to components, products, indicators or targets.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Electric bus fleet financing exists, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets on sustainable urban mobility.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Environmental benefits are indirect effects of energy-transition projects, not climate adaptation or risk-management initiatives.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Potential positive effects on productivity, but no objectives, indicators or targets on productive chains or business environment.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: R&D support and research-infrastructure initiatives exist, but no specific objectives, indicators or targets on innovation system impact.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Jobs indicator does not match the actions; job creation is an indirect effect of energy-transition investments.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Some adherence via lower-development municipalities, but no components, indicators or targets on regional inequality; the elements fit digital government better.

areas.name: Mining
areas.reason: Technological innovation financing in extraction exists, but no objectives, indicators or targets on the sector.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: Some adherence, but the elements were credited to the digital government area.

areas.name: International cooperation and regional development
areas.reason: No direct link between green hydrogen and biofuel support and international cooperation.
